    BO13a Lemma 6, case I: helpers and figure 6.1 #

    • RayCat.not_ftm_long_dom/cod: a long morphism divides a nonzero morphism with the same domain (codomain) only if it is a multiple of it.
    • RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_factors_both_last: dual of Lemma 4 b) (last arrows), via Pᵒᵖ.
    • RayQuiver.MulBasis.l6_fig61: figure 6.1 from the data of figure 6.0 and two morphisms t₀ → y₀, t₁ → y₁.
